text:
Cloud cost is running 16.0% above its baseline (medium severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is order-service (root-cause confidence 84%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along order-service -> database, database -> analytics. The next candidate, search-service (44%), was ruled out: its own change (user requests x1.10) is real but explains only 20% of the estimated cost increase. Estimated impact traced to order-service: $1,298/month.

Supporting evidence:
- Queries/request to database rose x3.49 (3.00 -> 10.48)
- Deployed v3.0 1h before its own behaviour changed
- Accounts for 79% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to database rose x3.50
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.98)

Recommended: Fix order-service query amplification to database. Estimated saving $1,384/month, latency -92.5%, error rate -0.46pp, risk low. Not recommended: Reduce database capacity 25%, because error rate +25.2pp > +0.5pp limit; DB CPU 132% > 85% headroom limit.
